I solved level 3 of game task-12b470cb in 36 actions. The human baseline is 26 and the cap is 130. The instance is over.

**How the game works:**
- If you click an empty cell within about 7 cells of a piece's bottom-right corner, the piece jumps so that corner lands on the clicked cell.
- If you click a single cell of colour a, it becomes a 2x2 square of colour 6. Each time, another cell of colour a also disappears.
- A click within range of two same-size pieces merges them. Two 6 squares make a 3x3 block of colour f. Two f blocks make a 4x4 block of colour b.
- The top panel shows the pieces you must build: one b block and one f block. Then you move them into the two circles of colour 9.

**What I did:** I built both pieces and put the f block in the right circle. Then I sent five jumps to move the b block into the left circle. The level completed on the fourth jump, at action 36. Then b was near the top of the left circle. I am not sure yet what exact position counts.
